note: Delta measurements are computed against token_audit_baseline.json estimates. Live actuals require running the pipeline with get_tracker().save_report() before and after each phase.

applied_to: All agents receiving raw findings lists from tool results
compress_for_triage: strips description/synopsis/solution prose, deduplicates CVE+asset pairs, filters min_cvss=7.0
compress_for_remediation: groups findings by fix action, one batch per agent call
compress_for_reporting: aggregate stats only, all raw noise stripped
notes: Token savings depend on raw finding payload size. compress_for_triage typically yields 60-75% reduction on the findings payload itself.
Total run savings are lower (31.7%) because system prompts and tool schemas are not affected by input compression.
Triage agents: 40% input reduction (filtered to High+Critical only, stripped prose)
Remediation agents: 60% reduction (grouped batches vs. individual findings)
Report agents (CISO persona): 90% reduction (counts only vs. full finding objects)

phases.technique: _build_system_prompt_cached() with cache_control: ephemeral on static system block
notes: Cache hits only apply after the first step of a multi-step run; first step is always a cache write at input cost.
Dynamic context (scratchpad/memory) is in a separate non-cached block — only static role definition is cached.
Effective cache hit rate: ~80% (4 out of 5 avg steps are cache reads)
CVE semantic cache (cve_cache.py): 24h TTL for KEV status, 7d for exploit data. Requires pipeline usage to populate.
